description: This file contains a set of Android activity classes demonstrating how to bind to and communicate with a remote service using Messenger IPC. The main class 'MessengerServiceActivities' includes an inner class 'Binding' that manages binding and message exchanges with the service, including handling connection lifecycle events and message passing.

classes.name: MessengerServiceActivities
classes.description: Container for activity classes related to Messenger service communication.

classes.name: MessengerServiceActivities.Binding
classes.description: An activity demonstrating binding to a remote Messenger service, handling connection, message passing, and service lifecycle.

classes.name: Binding.IncomingHandler
classes.description: Handler subclass for processing messages received from the service.

methods.name: doBindService
methods.description: Initiates binding to the Messenger service.

methods.name: doUnbindService
methods.description: Unbinds from the Messenger service and cleans up.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and attaches button handlers.
